title: 1681. Minimum Incompatibility

examples.explanation: The optimal distribution of subsets is [1,2] and [1,4]. The incompatibility is (2-1) + (4-1) = 4. Note that [1,1] and [2,4] would result in a smaller sum, but the first subset contains 2 equal elements.
The optimal distribution of subsets is [1,2], [2,3], [6,8], and [1,3]. The incompatibility is (2-1) + (3-2) + (8-6) + (3-1) = 6.
It is impossible to distribute nums into 3 subsets where no two elements are equal in the same subset.
